settype.title: Type
settype.remarks: Either COMPANY or ITEM. Enter the value or click the Select Value button.

enterdate.title: Entered Date
enterdate.remarks: Date and time the item set record was entered.

autoupdate.title: Automatically Add Companies to Company Master
autoupdate.remarks: Specifies whether you want Maximo to automatically create a Company Master record when a user adds a company in the Companies application. If the check box is selected, a Company Master record will be created. If the check box is cleared (the default), a Company Master record will not be created, and users must add companies in the Company Master application. This field only applies to sets of the TYPE COMPANY.

enterby.title: Entered By
enterby.remarks: Name of user who entered item set record.

hasld.title: Has Long Description
hasld.remarks: Boolean flag to indicate if there is any long description for this record

dfltitemstatus.title: Default Item Status
dfltitemstatus.remarks: The default item status for items added to the set.

setid.title: Set
setid.remarks: Identifies the set. This value must be unique for all sets. You cannot use the same identifier for a company set and an item set.
